body: Airbus and BAE Systems are set for talks over possible opportunities for the European planemaker to play a role in the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP), according to the Financial Times. The talks are expected to take place in the coming weeks and will cover a range of cooperation options, including uncrewed autonomous collaborative aircraft.

The programme is currently led by the United Kingdom, Italy and Japan. Its joint venture brings together BAE Systems, Leonardo and Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, along with Rolls-Royce, MBDA and Avio Aero. Airbus Defence and Space's chief executive told German media this month that Airbus wants a significant role in the programme rather than supplying minor components.

Germany's possible participation comes after the German-French fighter programme ended earlier this year. The United Kingdom's prime minister said on October 8, 2026 that the UK is open to Germany joining, speaking at a joint press conference with the German chancellor, with the aim of advancing the programme together with Italy and Japan. The report also notes that a strong Berlin push for a large design role could unsettle the programme and would need careful management, and that another option for Germany and Airbus would be cooperation with Sweden's Saab, maker of the Gripen fighter.
en.summary: Airbus and BAE Systems are set to hold talks in the coming weeks over possible opportunities for Airbus to play a role in the Global Combat Air Programme, according to the Financial Times. The programme is currently led by the United Kingdom, Italy and Japan, with Germany's possible participation under discussion.
en.title: Airbus set to discuss GCAP fighter opportunities with BAE Systems, FT reports

body: 據《金融時報》報導，空中巴士與英國航太系統（BAE Systems）將就空中巴士在全球作戰空中計畫（GCAP）中扮演角色的可能機會展開會談。會談預計在未來數週舉行，討論多種合作選項，其中包括無人自主協同作戰飛機。
該計畫目前由英國、義大利與日本主導，合資組成包括英國航太系統、李奧納多與三菱重工業，以及勞斯萊斯、MBDA與Avio Aero等公司。空中巴士防務與太空執行長本月接受德國媒體訪問時表示，希望在計畫中扮演重要角色，而非僅供應次要部件。
德國可能加入的背景，是德國與法國的戰機計畫今年稍早走到終點。英國首相於2026年10月8日表示，英國對德國加入持開放態度，並在與德國總理的聯合記者會上表達此意，未來將與義大利和日本共同推進。報導也提到，若柏林強力爭取大型設計角色，可能擾動計畫，因此合作需要謹慎管理；德國與空中巴士的另一選項，是與瑞典紳寶（Saab）合作，該公司生產獅鷲（Gripen）戰機。
zh.summary: 據《金融時報》報導，空中巴士與英國航太系統（BAE Systems）將在未來數週展開會談，討論空中巴士參與全球作戰空中計畫（GCAP）的可能機會。該計畫目前由英國、義大利與日本主導，德國可能加入。
zh.title: 金融時報：空中巴士將與英國航太系統商談GCAP戰機合作機會
